rows.TOP_COMMENT: Specify the status the system will automatically assign to the work order after the assignment status of the last activity is completed and all other activities are also completed. If blank, or if the entered value is not a valid value for the system code ’R’ (Released), the system will not change the work order status.

If "ON" when the status of the WO is Closed, all associated Activities are completed automatically. If "OFF" activities must be completed manually.  If “ERROR”, an error message will display if any Activities are not marked complete when closing a WO.

Recalculate People Required every time Estimated Hours or the work order activity duration changes: If ‘ON’, the system will recalculate and will validate that Estimated Hours is less or equal People Required * Duration * 24. If 'OFF', the system will only recalculate if People Required is blank and will not perform the validation.

Recalculate activity End Date and activity Duration if the Scheduled End Date of the work order changes: If ‘ON’, the system will recalculate and update the work order activities. If 'OFF', the system will not update activities.
Define one or more comma delimited user statuses for work order activity Assignment Status to indicate the dispatched work is complete.
Define the user status for work order activity Assignment Status that will be populated when the work order activity is dispatched from the GIS Map WO Dispatching screen.
Specify whether internal hours can be booked on an activity if Hired Labor is selected. If ‘YES’, internal labor hours can be booked. If 'NO', internal labor hours are not allowed.
Controls what will be displayed inside Activity dropdowns. Set to TRADE to display the description of the trade associated to the Activity. Set to NOTE to display the note associated to the activity.
Controls whether or not the system will copy the Task Plan Description to the Activity Note fields. Set to YES to copy and NO to not copy.

Selects the preferred supplier of a task plan or job plan on the work order activity; job; or plan labor record if Hired Labor is selected. If 'YES', the supplier will be populated if still blank, and a preferred supplier was found. If 'NO', supplier will remain blank and must be selected manually.

Determines resolution of the asset when the asset inventory session is approved, and the Observed Physical/Bin Location is NULL. If FOUND, then system sets the Resolution of the asset to "Asset Found". If NOTFOUND, system sets the resolution of the asset to "Asset Not Found". If BLOCK, the system does not allow approving the session if any unresolved assets exist.

When using "Retrieve PO Service Lines" on the Book PO labor Screen, system automatically populates the Hours Worked field for Hours for Service (ST) and Contractor Hire (SH) with the labor hours remaining to be booked for the selected line. Default value is 'NO'.

Cascade the scheduled dates for case tasks automatically based on the previous tasks and task duration: If 'SCHED', updates scheduled dates only. If 'BOTH', also updates requested start or end date if entered and the entered date conflicts with the schedule. If 'NO' the system will not automatically updates scheduled and requested dates.

At customer contract approval the system checks if equipment or projects are already used on another active contract with overlapping periods. If "ON" the system does not allow the use of the same equipment or projects more than once. If "OFF" the system does not perform this check. If "WARNING" the system will ask the user what to do. If "WARNING-CC" the system will also consider the charge categories on the other contract and only ask the user if those overlap as well.

Number of days after which no customer invoices will be generated. For Customer Contracts this is after the End Date. For Rentals after the Completed Date. The system will change the Status of the contract or the rental to Finished for this purpose.

Threshold at which the customer invoice regeneration process starts in asynchronous (background) mode: If the number of contract items multiplied with the number of charge definitions associated to the contract is higher than this setting the process runs asynchronous and the process will be queued. Otherwise the process runs synchronous and the user must wait for the process to finish.

Determines if a check is performed that all required checklist items are entered or not applicable when signing Performed By. If ‘ON’, the system will perform the check. If 'OFF', the signature can be entered without this validation. If ‘RESTRICTED’ the system will behave as if the option is set to ‘ON’, but will disallow Notes as a means to complete the checklist item. The restricted setting also impacts the work order close, even if the Performed By signature is not required.
Determines if follow up work orders or deferred maintenance activities are automatically generated when signing Reviewed By.

Determines how work order activities are grouped by schedule on the mobile Work Order Checklist screen. If ‘REG’, the system will use an overdue, due and future group. If 'WEEK', the system will split the month in week numbers where week 1 is day 1-7, week 2 is day 8-14, week 3 is day 15-21 and week 4 is day 22 through the end of the month, and will use these for grouping.

Controls how Regulatory checklist items, marked for Repairs can be completed. If N, then a valid resolution (or) a combination of a valid resolution and follow-up activity is required. If P, then a NULL resolution is allowed, along with a follow-up activity. If OFF, items can be completed without a resolution or follow-up activity.
Determines if the checklist must be renumbered based on the Route attached to the work order: If “YES” the checklist items will be renumbered.

If FULL, system displays the full tree structure in the closing code lookup with all the levels in the hierarchy. If GROUP, system displays just one level of the hierarchy. If OFF , the closing code lookup operates with no group or hierarchy. If HIERARCHY, the system displays the standard closing code lookups, but filters by the configured hierarchy.

Determines if standard work order Plan tools and PM schedule Plan tools are used to plan, schedule, or plan & schedule tools for work orders.  Set to 'P' to have Plan tool records copied only to the Plan Tools tab for work order.  Set to 'S' to have Plan tool records copied only to the Schedule Plan Tools tab for work order.  Set to 'B' to have Plan tool records used to populate both plan and schedule tools for work orders.  When set to 'B' a tool schedule record will be created for the planned hours for each day the activity runs.  Default value is 'P'.
Which lookup will be used to categorize capital planning requests: If CPRQ, the system will use the default Capital Request Categorization Codes. If EMRS the system will use EMRS codes instead.

Determines the number of days after which auto-generated work order sessions will be deleted.  Each time a session is created, the system will delete existing sessions older than the specified number of days.
Value for the Documoto Tenant Encrypted Key (tek).
URL for the Documoto Server.
Value for the Documoto username.
Determines the maximum number of equipment that can be generated synchronous.

Prevents the equipment generation process to create PM work orders if PM revision control is active: If “YES”, the system will generate PM work orders without asking for approval. If “NO” the system will not generate PM work orders. If “WARNING” the system will raise a warning massage during the Preview generation.
If "NO", no equipment can be generated when warnings exist.  If "YES", equipment can be generated even when warnings exist.

When receiving Direct Purchase material, set to "OPTIONAL" to make the Bin field optional. Set to "PROTECTED" to make the Bin field cleared and protected. Set to "REQUIRED" to make the Bin field required.
Allow issuing of Parts to Employee: If NO, Parts may not be issued to Employees; if YES, all Parts may be issued to Employees. If KITS ONLY, only Parts Tracked as Kits may be issued to Employees.
If "YES", system rules for validation and processing of invoices from external systems will be bypassed.  This organization option is for utilization with ION integrations. Default value is "NO".
Provide a default value for the Kit Lot Description field on Build Kit screen.
If YES, default the Part Pulled checkbox to checked on the Build Kit screen. If NO, default the Part Pulled checkbox to unchecked.
If NO, the system will not permit issuing a part that has expired (Lot Expiration Date). If YES, the system will allow issuing a part that has expired.
LOTO review frequency: Number of days from today after which a LOTO review will be required. Applied to the Date Review Required during the review of LOTO records.
LOTO review required: If "YES", deletion of LOTO records requires approval by a reviewer. If "NO" LOTO records can be deleted.

New revision of isolation point requires review of LOTO records: If "YES", at revision approval the system will reset the review data of the LOTO records that reference that isolation point for equipment and locations. If "NO" system will do nothing.

New revision of isolation point updates LOTO records: If "YES", at revision approval the system will apply the new isolation point data to the LOTO records that reference that isolation point for equipment and locations. If "NO" system will do nothing.

Specify the user status of the Supplier Return that is automatically generated when a received part is approved with a return quantity entered.  If blank or invalid the system will generate the return in approved status.  If a valid user status (Entity DOST) with a system code of U, R, or A the system will generate the return with the designated status.
Determines which equipment to copy to route-based PM work orders. Select 'C' for route equipment only, 'H' for header equipment only, or 'B' to have both header and route equipment copied.

This setting only applies to the WO Checklist screen in Mobile. Set to CHECKLIST to have the system open the WO Checklist Details screen when a WO is selected. Set to WO to open the regular Work Order screen when a WO is selected.
Controls whether or not the system will generate a Nonconformity when a Notebook record is created. Set to YES to create the Nonconformity automatically and NO to not create Nonconformities.

Prevents finishing operator checklist if checklist items exist that have follow-up selected but for which no follow-up work order is created: If ‘YES’, prevent finishing the Operator checklist. If 'WARNING', the user will receive a warning message but will be allowed to continue and finish the Operator Checklist. If 'NO' the system will not perform the check.

Determines if the follow-up work order can have multiple activities with different From Points and To Points: If 'YES', this is allowed. If 'NO', this is not allowed and one follow-up work order will be created for each activity with a unique From and To Point combination.
System hides the Create Follow-up WO link button when set to DM and makes available the “Create Deferred Maintenance” link button.

Specify the status of the operator checklist when the Move to Complete button is clicked, and no records exist on the Operator checklist tab of screen setup screen. Possible values for the OPST entity are: 'C' (Complete), 'R' (Review) , 'U' (Unfinished).
Determines if follow up work orders or deferred maintenance activities are automatically generated when signing Reviewed By.

Controls how Regulatory checklist items, marked for Repairs can be completed. If N, then a valid resolution (or) a combination of a valid resolution and follow up work order is required. If P, then a NULL resolution is allowed, along with a follow up work order.
Value for the OneSource Audit Status. Valid values are Yes (Y), TRUE, No (N), or FALSE.  This will populate the tag <IS_AUDITED> in the request file.
Value for the OneSource Company Name.  This is the name of the corporate entity or the organization’s company name.  This will populate the tag COMPANY_NAME in the request file.
Value for the OneSource External Company ID.  This will populate the tag <EXTERNAL_COMPANY_ID> in the request file.
Value for the OneSource Filter Group Name.  This specifies the TransEditor group to use.  This will populate the tag <FILTER_GROUP_NAME> in the request file.
Value for the OneSource Filter Group Owner.  This specifies the company of the TransEditor group to use.  This will populate the tag <FILTER_GROUP_OWNER> in the request file.
Value for the OneSource Product Mapping Group Name.  This identifies the configuration group in the OneSource application.
Value for the OneSource Product Mapping Group Owner.  This will populate the tag <PRODUCT_MAPPING_GROUP_OWNER> in the request file.
Value for the OneSource Transaction Type.  This field is used for the benefit of a VAT (non-US) transaction.  Default value is GS.  This will populate the tag <TRANSACTION_TYPE> in the request file
rows.TOP_VALIDVALUES: AT, T1, T2, CL, DS, ES, GS, IN, MV, PP, PC, RR, SI, TG, TP, TS, WG

rows.TOP_COMMENT: If YES, allow to receive more than ordered; if NO, do not allow to receive more than ordered.

Determines if Direct Purchase materials are to be received directly to work order or to store (as held item). When receiving Direct Purchase material, set to "WO" to have the Direct to WO checkbox default to checked. Set to "HELD" to have the Direct to WO checkbox default to unchecked.

Cleanup permits after work order changes: If "NO", the system will do nothing. If "DEACT" the system will deactivate permits that are not referenced anymore. If "DEL" the system will delete these permit references.
Mandatory Permit Deactivation: If "YES", mandatory permits on the work order can be deactivated. If "NO" deactivation is not allowed.
Permit review frequency: Number of days from today after which a permit review will be required. Applied to the Date Review Required during the review of permit records.
Permit review required: If "YES", deletion of permit records requires approval by a reviewer. If "NO" Permit records can be deleted.

New revision of permit requires review of permit records: If "YES", at revision approval the system will reset the review data of the permit records that reference that permit for equipment, locations, categories, PM Schedules and Standard Work Orders. If "NO" system will do nothing.

New revision of permit updates permit records: If "YES", at revision approval the system will apply the new permit data to the permit records that reference that permit for equipment, locations, categories, PM Schedules and Standard Work Orders. If "NO" system will do nothing.

Set to “NEW” to update the Last Meter Reading field on Work Order type ‘PPM’ to the most recent reading when WO Status is changed from any status to a  system status of ‘C’. Set to “INITIAL” to update when WO Status is changed from a system status that is not ‘C’ to a system status of ‘C’ during first close only. Set to “OFF” to not update on status change.
Determines if a Revision Reason is required when creating a new revision of a PO.

Determines if a new supplier catalog record will be created for a part on a purchasing contract if such catalog record does not exist yet. If “ON” a record will be created immediately when the part is added to the contract. If set to “APPR” one or more records may be created when the contract is approved. If set to “OFF” no catalog records will be created.
Auto creation of permit to work (PTW): If "YES", permit to work will be automatically created for work orders that require them. If "NO" creation is manual.

When entering a PTW conflict record the system will create a second conflict record attached to the conflicting PTW pointing back to the PTW the conflict is created for. This option controls how this second record is created: If set to "MANUAL", system creates this second conflict record but leaves the resolution blank and flags the conflicting PTW that un-assessed conflicts exist. If "SYNC", the system will set the resolution based on the selection for the originating conflict and will not flag the conflicting PTW.

Determines which permit to work will automatically expire if Valid Until is in the past: If ‘ACTIVE’, only active permits will expire. If 'ALL', any permit that is not closed or cancelled will expire.
Limits the number of open PTWs per work order: If "YES", only one open PTW is allowed at any one moment in time. If "NO" there is no constraint.

Create PTWs for multi equipment child work order: If "YES", PTW is created for MEC work order. If "NO" PTW will still be created, but will be attached to the multi equipment work order, i.e. the parent.

Determines if the LOTO tab of the permit to work can be updated after approval. If set to YES, LOTO tab can be updated unless the permit to work is cancelled or closed. If set to NO, the LOTO tab can only be updated if the permit to work is unfinished.
If "YES", the reliability calculations will include PM work orders in the selection if they have the appropriate Closing Code entered. If "NO" PM work orders will be excluded.
If Y, the system will create Multiple Equipment Child type work orders for each route equipment when route based PM work orders are released.   They will be related to the parent job.

Determines if the Preferred Supplier on the Stores tab of Part is used to default the Supplier on the Parts tab of Requisition when manually creating a Requisition.  Set to STORE to use the Preferred Supplier on the Stores tab of Part. If blank, then use the Preferred Supplier on the Suppliers tab of Part.  Set to SUPPLIER to use the Preferred Supplier on the Suppliers tab of Part.  The Preferred Supplier on the Stores tab of Part will not be considered in this case.  Note: If the Supplier is populated on the header of the Requisition, that value will always be defaulted to the Parts tab.

Enable the user to generate a purchase order from the Generate PO button on the Requisition record view in a selected default user status.  The parameter value can be any valid user status code for the entity DOST associated to a system code of U, R, or A.  The user must have status authorization to create a purchase order from '-' to the designated status.
Safety review frequency: Number of days from today after which a safety review will be required. Applied to the Date Review Required during the review of safety records.
Safety review required: If "YES", deletion of safety records requires approval by a reviewer. If "NO" safety records can be deleted.

New revision of hazard and precaution requires review of safety records: If "YES", at revision approval the system will reset the review data of the safety records that reference that precaution for equipment, locations, categories, parts, PM Schedules and Standard Work Orders. If "NO" system will do nothing.

New revision of precaution updates safety records: If "YES", at revision approval the system will apply the new precaution data to the safety records that reference that precaution for equipment, locations, categories, parts, PM Schedules and Standard Work Orders. If "NO" system will do nothing.
Set to “ALL” to display all Equipment. Set to “ASSOCIATED” to display equipment associated to the contact.

Determines if the system should maintain a structure record between the header equipment and the segment or the route, if a record is inserted or deleted on the Segments or Routes tab of the equipment screens. If set to I, a structure record will be created at insert. If set to D, the structure record will be removed at delete. If set to ID, the structure is maintained both at insert and delete. If set to OFF, the system will do nothing.

Show temporary material lists created on work orders in material list lookups: If “YES”, these temporary material lists will be displayed in the lookups. If “NO”, these temporary material lists will not be displayed in the lookups.

Determines the level at which MEC work orders will be created after using the Trace Route feature. If set to "ROUTE", the system will create the MEC work orders for the selected routes. If set to "SEGMENT", work orders will be created for the segments attached to the selected routes.

Determines if booking hours across midnight is allowed. If set to YES, then the system will create two booked labor records in this scenario. If set to NO, then the system will prevent booking hours across midnight.

Determines if book labor corrections can be made directly on the screen or only via the dedicated Book Labor Correction popup. If set to ON, the popup must be used for all book labor corrections. If set to OFF, the system will allow the entry of negative hours directly on the screen and will not require the popup.

Prevents closing work orders if checklist items exist that have follow-up selected but for which no follow-up work order is created: If “YES”, prevent closing the work order. If “WARNING”, the user will receive a warning message but will be allowed to continue and close the work order. If “NO” the system will not perform the check.

Determines if equipment changes on the work order will default equipment related data. If set to YES, the equipment change will overwrite values already entered on the work order from the selected equipment. If set to NO, then the system will not default any values from the equipment.  Note this option only handles equipment changes. If the equipment field is still blank before the equipment value is entered, values will always be defaulted, as if the option is set to YES.

Determines if the follow-up work order can have multiple activities with different From Points and To Points: If “YES”, this is allowed. If “NO”, this is not allowed and one follow-up work order will be created for each activity with a unique From and To Point combination.
Determines what kind of follow-up a checklist will generate: If “DM”, Deferred Maintenance activities will be created. If “WO”, the follow-up will be a work order.

Set to "NEW" to update the Last Meter Reading field on Work Order to the most recent reading when WO Status is changed to a new system status of 'C'. Set to "INITIAL" to update when WO Status is changed from a system status that is not 'C' to a system status of 'C'. Set to "OFF" to not update on status change.

Specify a Work Order user status with a System Status of R or C.  The system will automatically set the New Status field on the Work Order Quick Close screen to this value.  If NULL or invalid, the screen will use the System default for C.
Default user status code assigned to Released preventive maintenance and maintenance pattern work orders.
Set to "YES" to have the Select checkbox turned on by default for new Associations to Work Space Moves.  Set to "NO" to have the Select checkbox turned off by default.
